# Generated by tools/generate_good_transport_helpers.sh.
# Do not edit manually.
# Converts a known trade-capacity-like volume into an estimated goods quantity.
# This does not read exact vanilla trade quantity and must not mutate stock.
# Source: <EU5_GAME_COMMON_DIR>/goods.

cbp_get_transport_cost_good_cotton = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_good_transport_cost_raw
		value = 1
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_good_transport_cost_defaulted value = 1 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_good_transport_cost
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_good_transport_cost_raw
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}
}

cbp_compute_goods_quantity_from_trade_capacity_good_cotton = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
		value = {
			value = $capacity_volume$
			min = 0
		}
	}

	cbp_get_transport_cost_good_cotton = yes

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_computed_goods_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
			divide = scope:cbp_good_transport_cost
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_estimated_goods_quantity value = scope:cbp_computed_goods_quantity }
}

cbp_compute_goods_quantity_from_trade_capacity_with_route_good_cotton = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
		value = {
			value = $capacity_volume$
			min = 0
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
		value = {
			value = $route_cost_multiplier$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	cbp_get_transport_cost_good_cotton = yes

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_good_transport_cost
			multiply = scope:cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_computed_goods_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
			divide = scope:cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_estimated_goods_quantity value = scope:cbp_computed_goods_quantity }
}

cbp_diagnostic_trade_capacity_conversion_good_cotton = {
	cbp_compute_goods_quantity_from_trade_capacity_good_cotton = {
		capacity_volume = $capacity_volume$
	}
}

		name = cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
		value = {
			value = $capacity_volume$
			min = 0
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
		value = {
			value = $route_cost_multiplier$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	cbp_get_transport_cost_good_coal = yes

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_good_transport_cost
			multiply = scope:cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_computed_goods_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
			divide = scope:cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_estimated_goods_quantity value = scope:cbp_computed_goods_quantity }
}

cbp_diagnostic_trade_capacity_conversion_good_coal = {
	cbp_compute_goods_quantity_from_trade_capacity_good_coal = {
		capacity_volume = $capacity_volume$
	}
}

		name = cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
		value = {
			value = $capacity_volume$
			min = 0
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
		value = {
			value = $route_cost_multiplier$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	cbp_get_transport_cost_good_slaves_goods = yes

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_good_transport_cost
			multiply = scope:cbp_trade_route_cost_multiplier
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_computed_goods_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_trade_capacity_volume_raw
			divide = scope:cbp_trade_quantity_denominator
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_estimated_goods_quantity value = scope:cbp_computed_goods_quantity }
}

cbp_diagnostic_trade_capacity_conversion_good_slaves_goods = {
	cbp_compute_goods_quantity_from_trade_capacity_good_slaves_goods = {
		capacity_volume = $capacity_volume$
	}
}

# cotton sugar tobacco tar naval_supplies weaponry leather masonry silk tea cocoa coffee fiber_crops ivory salt pearls amber saltpeter alum wine mercury wool wild_game fur fish wheat maize rice millet potato livestock olives beeswax slaves_goods
